column1: 100106_description=The [Shooter] offers an excellent balance of performance for its low price, making it a dependable companion for enforcers who have only just shed their rookie status.

100197_description=An enhanced version of the Shooter, the [Veteran Shooter] is a C-class shotgun whose rare combination of exceptional performance and limited-edition scarcity keeps its popularity from ever cooling.
100206_description=A weapon that reinterprets and revives an early Flinger in a modern style. Its parts are easy to obtain, and its low repair cost makes it very popular among beginners.

100297_description=Adding powerful attack power to the pump's excellent balance, the [Veteran Pump] proves especially potent in areas of high contamination. With its designer's sudden disappearance, it can no longer be manufactured, making its rarity extremely high as well.

100407_description=A machine gun that modified the locator of the standard-issue machine gun to slightly raise its damage per second. It was given the name [Zero] to signify that it was the first prototype of the modified machine guns.

100497_description=To cover Zero's frequently criticized weakness of low contamination resistance, an anti-contamination coating was applied to the firearm, greatly improving much of its contamination resistance. The [Veteran Zero] is one of the finest machine guns even within Class C.

100507_description=Because it uses sturdier components than the standard-issue Rocket Launcher, it offers a major advantage in durability consumption, making it much beloved by novice Avengers struggling for funds.

100597_description=The [Veteran Fist], developed as an enhanced version of the Fist, was in fact a weapon that master modder 'J.J' sold off in small numbers as a side hobby. But as more and more Avengers took it up for its higher damage compared to the Fist, DISCORDIA Corp. felt threatened and scouted 'J.J', so it is now a highly rare weapon no longer in production at all.

100707_description=The [Cat's Eye] replaces the barrel of the standard-issue sniper rifle with a high-rigidity alloy barrel and adopts dedicated rounds, drawing out above-average attack power while achieving stable balance.

100797_description=A powerful sniper rifle whose per-second damage surpasses that of a middling B-class sniper rifle, the [Veteran Cat's Eye] realizes a step up in attack power over the Cat's Eye, making it the top-grade C-class sniper rifle. However, its very high production cost means it has already been discontinued and cannot easily be obtained, which stands as the greatest obstacle.

100853_description=A Regulator designed to induce greater shield reduction, based on the Standard-Issue Regulator. Its repair cost is relatively cheap and it is easy to obtain, making it a Regulator that is very popular among novice Phantoms.

100897_description=The [Veteran Drain] is a weapon regarded as a masterwork among C-class Regulators, successfully catching both rabbits of performance balance and attack power. It is a regrettable weapon in that, due to the high crafting difficulty and expensive production cost of the balance stabilization device it employs, it cannot be obtained at all from ordinary shops.
108101_description=Boasting formidable targeting accuracy, the [Deer Hunter] is one of DISCORDIA's most ambitious creations, built with the finest engineering.
108102_description=One of DISCORDIA's most ambitious creations, the [Storm] is a shotgun that delivers powerful firepower while landing its rounds on target with relative accuracy.

108201_description=A Flinger for trainee soldiers that competed with the 'Frog.' Despite its outstanding explosion radius, it was a model that went unchosen due to its shortcomings in damage performance.
108202_description=Living up to its name, the [Buffalo] boasts a powerful explosion radius and is a model with excellent power. Its one flaw is a lack of stability.

108401_description=Any rookie who's handled a machine gun for a while ends up looking for this one. It's harder to control than the machine guns already on the market, but its improved damage makes it well worth recommending to any rookie who's grown comfortable with machine guns.

108402_description=The hardest-hitting machine gun among all existing Grade C machine guns. It's no exaggeration to say that every Grade C Avenger is racking up kills and earning Pcr just to get their hands on this weapon.

108501_description=A model that suitably raises both the rocket's direct-hit damage and its splash-damage radius. A recruit who has mastered the basics of the Rocket Launcher would do well to choose this model.

108502_description=A Rocket Launcher that maximizes rocket direct-hit damage and rate of fire among Grade C models. Thanks to its outstanding rate of fire, it can pressure enemies at range and unleash relentless continuous attacks, making it a welcome model on the battlefield.
108701_description=As with most standard-type sniper rifles, but the [Hawk Down] carries an even more finely tuned balance. On top of that, its added biochemical damage effect is a bonus.

108702_description=As the name [Katana] suggests, it carries an edge so keen it seems it would cut you at the lightest touch, a weapon belonging to the top tier of Grade C sniper rifles. Beware the Phantom wielding a [Katana]. You never know when your head might come flying off.

108801_description=A standard-issue Regulator for novice Phantoms who have just left training, designed to be light and easy to use with excellent zoom performance. Its very high enemy shield reduction rate also lets it perform well in combat.

108802_description=A Regulator with damage rarely seen at C Grade. Because it was built as a fully offensive type, its allied shield regeneration rate is somewhat lacking, but with high damage and a decent enemy shield reduction rate, it is favored by everyone from Phantoms about to be promoted to B Grade up through novice B Grade Phantoms.

109101_description=The base model of an anti-personnel shotgun meticulously crafted by DISCODA at the request of Military Command, this weapon is highly appealing for its high attack power and low equip level. However, since the entire production run is delivered to Command, it can only be used with Command's authorization, and its very low contamination rating means it cannot be used as an anti-hybrid weapon.
109101_summary=[Grade C] Damage-type Shotgun\nCannot be tuned up

109201_description=A military-exclusive Flinger that is a great help to novice Enforcers on the battlefield, the [Standard-Issue FLI-1C] is a damage-type Flinger that accepts every drawback to push firepower as high as possible.
109201_summary=[Grade C] Damage-type Flinger\nCannot be tuned up

109501_description=Simple in performance just as in its name, the [ROC-1C] was born for one purpose only: killing people. Though restricted to Class C, it boasts top-tier anti-personnel attack power, with few peers among Rocket Launchers of its class.

109701_description=Built by special directive of Military Command to draw Phantoms who shun close combat onto the battlefield, the [Standard-Issue SNI-3C] is a superb weapon that adds a special elemental attack to powerful damage.
109701_summary=[Grade C] Damage Sniper Rifle\nCannot Tune Up

109851_description=A Regulator ambitiously designed and manufactured by Command in order to cultivate Regulator-type Phantoms, who are extremely rare in anti-personnel combat. With its low equip level, it is a model very highly praised by beginner Phantoms.

111101_description=The [Big Shot] is a top-tier B-class standard shotgun that puts out consistently strong all-around performance while packing damage powerful enough to threaten same-class damage-type shotguns. If you can accept its rather high price and the inconvenience of having to renew its biometric recognition periodically, it is without a doubt the strongest shotgun in its class.
111101_summary=[Grade B] Standard-type Shotgun\nCannot be tuned up

111201_description=Named for the inverted-cone pit gouged out by a violent volcanic eruption, the [Crater] lives up to its name, carving countless craters across the battlefield with powerful damage, stable balance, and even performance, making it the finest Grade B Flinger.
111201_summary=[Grade B] Standard-type Flinger\nCannot be tuned up

111401_description=With each and every shot like a sharp dagger tearing into the heart, the [Fencer] is a masterpiece that beautifully harmonizes the two performance qualities of stability and attack power, once thought incompatible, delivering powerful damage unbecoming of a standard-issue model.

111501_description=If you take the common opinion at face value, that this weapon offers merely average performance for a rather steep price, then the [Burning Launcher] deserves a closer look. Built on a stable performance balance, it is a compelling weapon capable of pumping out formidable damage per second.
111701_description=This sniper rifle, granted the name [Slayer], will brand you into the enemy's mind as a true killer.
111701_summary=[Grade B] Standard Sniper Rifle\nCannot Tune Up
111851_description=Named because its blue flash so closely resembles a beam saber, the [Lightsaber] is a Regulator whose outstanding performance is no less remarkable than its beautiful appearance.
118101_description=The [Crusher] is a shotgun produced by DISCORDIA's standard weapon mass-production system, boasting powerful firepower that many enforcers favor.
118102_description=The [Squall] is a shotgun whose damage is so powerful that its rounds stir up a fierce gust of wind after firing.

118103_description=Despite the drawback of slightly lower damage, the [Needle] can strike a wide area in a short time with its rapid rate of fire, earning it the exclusive devotion of enforcers craving that satisfying feeling.
118104_description=The [Stone Cold] fires powerful rounds that can deal lethal damage to enemies. It is a shotgun famed for delivering devastating blows, though it suffers from a low rate of fire.

118201_description=A Flinger model that MODIEN is rumored to have developed in secret through backroom deals with shadowy organizations. Despite its excellent performance, a wide blast radius and large magazine capacity, its weak damage and poor durability are its unfortunate drawbacks.
118202_description=The [Dunker], manufactured by COLLEIN, is the highest-damage Flinger in Grade B. Enemies will be thrown into utter panic by the [Dunker]'s rounds slamming down upon them.
118203_description=Capable of agile attacks, the [Bullfrog] is a powerful Flinger boasting overwhelming rate of fire and a massive magazine capacity, well worth recommending to veteran soldiers.

118204_description=The [Buffalo P] is the successor to the Buffalo, the finest Grade B Flinger boasting lethal damage backed by even more powerful performance. However, the poor safety flagged in its predecessor was never addressed.

118301_description=Built on DISCORDIA's mass-production system, the [Fire Whisper] is a Discharger made for balanced handling rather than raw power. It is consistently regarded by many as a dependable weapon.

118302_description=True to its name, which refers to the flames blooming at the sun's edge, GINALON's [Prominence] boasts the finest damage in Grade B. Some say its range performance suffers due to pressure issues in the spray nozzle, but the prevailing opinion is that there is no better weapon for burning enemies to ash.

118303_description=The [Prison Arrow] is a cryo-type Discharger crafted by MODIEN's top engineering team. Thanks to its special nozzle, it boasts excellent range. Its liquid-nitrogen cryo attacks are powerful, making it beloved by veteran soldiers.

118304_description=The [Fire Whip] is named for its long, extending pillar of flame that resembles a whip of fire. It boasts a longer range than ordinary Dischargers, and its power is nothing to scoff at either.
118401_description=A Grade B standard machine gun boasting stable performance, as befits a weapon made by DISCORDIA. Many Avengers favor it for all-purpose use.

118402_description=A machine gun boasting powerful firepower. Rather than a high-pressure gas system, it adopts an electromagnetic recoil firing method, allowing it to deal powerful damage to enemies.

118403_description=The best rate of fire among commercially available Grade B machine guns. It can also load more ammunition than other machine guns, making it specialized for sustained fire. If you want to whip up a sandstorm on the battlefield, this gun comes highly recommended.

118404_description=The most powerful firepower among commercially available Grade B machine guns. It was developed by modernizing and improving the [Captain Black] model favored by the war hero Major Black. For any Avenger craving overwhelming firepower, it's an essential item.

118501_description=A Rocket Launcher released under the motto of reducing its target to ashes. Well-balanced in every quality a Rocket Launcher should have, it stands without shame as a front-runner among standard-issue Rocket Launchers.

118502_description=A Rocket Launcher that boasts the most powerful firepower among Grade B Rocket Launchers capable of long-range attacks. Because the rocket's penetration is increased, the explosion does not spread widely in all directions. It delivers an effective attack when it lands a direct hit.

118503_description=A Rocket Launcher that minimizes recoil to raise rate of fire and boosts rocket thrust to swiftly overwhelm distant targets. Its rockets have somewhat weaker explosive power, but it is a welcome model for Avengers who favor fast, rapid-fire attacks.

118504_description=An Avenger who uses the Rocket Launcher as a primary weapon is vulnerable in close-range combat, but an Avenger wielding the [Body Check] has nothing to fear. Boasting the most powerful destructive force among Grade B Rocket Launchers, this model can deal a massive critical hit to nearby targets. Pair it with a long-range weapon and you will become the ultimate Avenger.

118601_description=Building on the technology of its early products, DISCORDIA succeeded in producing an optical rifle with improved Luna Core energy output and firing precision. It can be called the flagship of Grade B optical rifles.

118602_description=The [Thunderdog] was upgraded into a damage-type weapon by fitting it with a Luna Cube that emits a high-output optical beam. Due to production costs, no investment could be made in the cooling system or the lens, so its rate of fire and accuracy fall somewhat short of the standard model.

118603_description=GINALON's craftsmanship is on full display even in its optical rifles. Equipped with a precision optical lens and a light, efficient cooling system, this model boasts the finest Grade B performance in accuracy and rate of fire.

118611_description=A model developed by PEOPLEZ for soldiers who want rate of fire and accuracy over destructive power. By improving the cooling system to raise the rate of fire and, at the same time, enlarging the diameter of the optical ball, it was designed to make enemies easier to hit.

118612_description=The militaries of both camps commissioned a model capable of elemental attacks in order to distribute to their soldiers the elemental attack fitted to HLO's optical rifles. MODIEN, a maker of specialized weapons, analyzed HLO's model and developed the [Venomstriker], capable of a virulent poison elemental attack.

118613_description=Luna Flux technology, which can shape powerful energy into a ball form, was an opportunity for DISCORDIA. This firm, specialized in developing high-destruction weapons, introduced technology that raised energy output while also enlarging the ball's diameter, and released [GS-201], the first work in the high-destruction GS series.

118701_description=A weapon that stands out for its Normal performance, a standard-type sniper rifle for the beginner-to-intermediate player first stepping into B class. The [Executor] is the very thing that carries out its assigned duty under any adverse condition.

118702_description=A Grade B damage-type sniper rifle that reflects COLLEIN's character to the letter. Its powerful damage, which overcomes an awkward zoom magnification and a small base magazine capacity, is its appeal, and true to its name it is chosen by many Phantoms for its formidable destructive power.

118703_description=The first model to mount PEOPLEZ's cutting-edge rate-of-fire enhancement device, a weapon whose outstanding firing speed seems capable of felling even the legendary phantasmal beast, the dragon.

118704_description=Mercy toward the enemy is a useless emotion that drives you to your own death. Yet ironically, is not the [No Mercy], which grants death before the opponent has a moment to feel pain, the greatest mercy one can offer an enemy? In any case, the outstanding firing speed born from the combination of the rate-of-fire enhancement device and the explosive-performance enhancement device is the highlight of the [No Mercy].

118801_description=Setting the standard for B Grade Regulators, the [Black Shadow] is a representative weapon of the standard-issue Regulator, boasting stable damage, an enemy shield reduction rate, and an allied shield regeneration rate.

118802_description=Experience damage that could not be seen in the existing B Grade! The [K-2] invites you into the world of the damage Regulator. You will be thoroughly enthralled by the charm of the [K-2], which nullifies the enemy's shield and delivers a powerful energy shock to incapacitate them.

118803_description=A cutting-edge rapid-fire Regulator that mounts a high-speed Luna energy charging device, shortening the recharge time after firing Luna energy to achieve a high rate of fire. The fame of the [Eclipse] will continue on into the future.

118811_description=The [Drain P] is the result of modifying the [Drain], prized for its simplicity and economy, and achieving a sweeping upgrade to its performance. Though the zoom scope is omitted, as with most area Regulators, it has won the affection of many users through enhancements to its other stats.

118812_description=This weapon, whose ridiculous name brings a slight smile, is a product of chance born from a tuning engineer's mistake. But its performance is no laughing matter. It has an exceptional knack for scattering powerful damage across an area to neutralize the shields of clustered enemies. Engineers! If these are the mistakes, we earnestly pray you keep making them.

118813_description=Radiance was not a particularly excellent Phantom at handling Regulators. For him, the best choice was the area Regulator, and through a tuning method suited to himself he was reborn as a master of Regulator rapid fire.

118901_description=[Hell Diver] is an Inquisitor whose capabilities swing to extremes depending on the operator's skill. A small tip: there is a firing method that sends the round soaring high above the target before plunging it down to deal massive damage. This is the signature launch technique of [Hell Diver], the one that drags foes down to hell.

118902_description=[Star Streak] is a standard-issue Inquisitor fitted with a newly developed blast-enhancement device in its warhead to widen the explosion radius, engineered to deal heavy primary damage along with a broad area of effect around the target.

118903_description=[Albatross] is the first Inquisitor to apply the Trade Off principle: reduce warhead weight to gain a range advantage. On top of that, a blast-enhancement device is mounted in the warhead so it can fly farther and faster to destroy its target.

118904_description=[Raven], a control-enhanced Inquisitor equipped with a high-sensitivity remote unit and a self-illuminating display, shows first-rate maneuverability, banking so nimbly, like a swift crow, that it earned the name [Raven].

119101_description=An upgraded version of the Standard-Issue SH-1C', the [Standard-Issue SH-13B] is an anti-personnel shotgun that requires Command's authorization to use and cannot be used in contaminated zones. Even so, it boasts powerful performance that more than makes up for those limitations.
119101_summary=[Grade B] Damage-type Shotgun\nCannot be tuned up

119201_description=The [Standard-Issue FLI-15B], usable by any B-Class Enforcer approved by Military Command, is a damage-type Flinger specialized for anti-personnel combat. Contamination-related features were thoroughly excluded from the earliest stages of its design, so performance in polluted zones is not to be expected, but on the battlefield its performance is peerless!
119201_summary=[Grade B] Damage-type Flinger\nCannot be tuned up

119401_description=The [Standard-Issue MAC-16B], a weapon with the unusual history of having an illegally modified version of the standard-issue MAC-2C' refined and adopted as an official military supply, is a weapon distinguished by best-in-class damage and anti-personnel combat capability. Since the illegally modified version is no longer available, you must obtain government authorization to use this weapon.

119501_description=Modified and upgraded from the ROC-1C' to meet B-class specs, this anti-personnel rocket launcher is specially issued by Command to warriors who never had the chance to prepare a dedicated anti-personnel weapon. Though it requires a demanding approval process, its outstanding performance is more than worth the effort.

119701_description=The military version of the 'Slayer', the [Standard-Issue SNI-15B] is a Grade B military sniper rifle built with cost-to-performance in mind, stripping out parts relatively unimportant to anti-personnel combat.
119701_summary=[Grade B] Damage Sniper Rifle\nCannot Tune Up

119851_description=A Regulator designed to induce greater shield reduction, based on the Standard-Issue REG-8C'. Because it remains unapproved for use in contaminated zones, it cannot exert much power outside of anti-personnel combat areas.
120220_description=A high-grade beginner's weapon developed by MIRAGE. It is the standard model, said to be the easiest to use, and was produced as a limited edition.

120521_description=A limited-run, intermediate-grade product crafted with all his might by Mr. Cadler, the artisan weaponsmith who has stubbornly developed nothing but rocket launchers. Cadler is famous for giving his creations strange names; he reportedly named this rocket launcher 'Pinto' for no other reason than that its packaging box had a mottled pattern.

120821_description=Mrs. Sherlivan, a weaponsmith famed for her beautiful optical arms, crafted this limited-edition Regulator for intermediate users with fantastic performance, and soldiers waited eagerly for its release. But once it was named [Phoenix], after the male figure of Greek myth, it was saddled with the stigma of being a "wimp's weapon."

121101_description=Boasting even greater damage and performance than its predecessor, the [Big Shot P] is the object of envy among A-Class Enforcers. With A-Class top-tier firepower, durability, and a stable weapon balance, its flawless performance makes it fair to call the pinnacle of A-Class shotguns.
121101_summary=[Grade A] Standard-type Shotgun\nCannot be tuned up

121201_description=An upgraded version of the 'Crater', this weapon is a standard-type Flinger that raises every aspect of its performance by a step. Its attack power is no less than that of a damage-enhanced Flinger, making it the finest Grade A Flinger that any Enforcer well-versed in Flingers would want to equip.

121401_description=The [Veteran Fencer], which finishes the 'Fencer's barrel in high-strength titanium alloy to reduce recoil and raise attack power, is a weapon that can without exaggeration be called the pinnacle of Grade A standard-issue machine guns.

121501_description=Among Avengers who had been using the 'Burning Launcher,' demand ran high for a comparable Grade A rocket launcher. In response, MIRAGE poured its efforts into upgrading the 'Burning Launcher,' and at last the masterpiece known as the [Burning Launcher MKII] was born.

121701_description=The 'Slaughterer' returns as the [Slaughterer 2] through continuous upgrades. By boldly adopting the Taconium rate-of-fire control unit and high-performance system control chip previously reserved for Grade S, it doubles stability and greatly enhances firepower, reborn as the finest Grade A weapon to carry on its predecessor's fame.
121701_summary=[Grade A] Standard Sniper Rifle\nCannot Tune Up

121851_description=The [Lightsaber P], which inherits the name of its predecessor 'Lightsaber', has had every part of its design reworked to reinforce the luna energy emitter. Rumor has it they intended to paint the exterior blue, but the powerful energy projectiles scorched the surface red, forcing them to abandon the blue coat.

128101_description=The [Crash] is famous for its wide spread angle, good rate of fire, and the thunderous roar it makes when firing. True to its name, it is a DISCORDIA standard shotgun that helped shape the image of enforcers charging across the battlefield with a deafening roar.

128102_description=The [Honor] is a MIRAGE shotgun boasting the best firepower and durability in A-grade. Along with its powerful firepower, its excellent durability has earned it high praise from many enforcers.

128103_description=A high-quality MIRAGE shotgun that, backed by a powerful rate of fire, rapidly fires specialized rounds embedded with a nano electric shocker to deliver an electric shock to the target. Its one flaw is that the rounds are slightly lacking in power.

128104_description=The [Crash S] further develops the strengths of its predecessor, widening the round spread angle even more for easier aiming and using an A-grade top-performance rate-of-fire enhancer to push its firing rate to the maximum. Some dismiss it as a mere sidegrade, but it has grown so popular that groups of enforcers who use the [Crash S] have sprung up.
128105_description=The [Honor S] is a work that greatly improves upon its predecessor's durability performance, earning a warm welcome from enforcers who aim for economical combat.

128106_description=By replacing the electric-shock rounds of its predecessor, the 'Iron Maiden,' with rapid-fire standard rounds, the [Iron Maiden S] pushes versatility even higher. It is a rapid-fire shotgun that solves the chronic durability flaws inherent to special ammunition.

128201_description=A weapon with a short firing range but comparatively excellent balance. Produced by DISCORDIA's standard-issue mass-production system, the [Cruel] is a Flinger that shines with stable balance and rugged durability.

128202_description=Built with Grade A's finest technology, COLLEIN's [Battle Sling] is a Flinger boasting the highest firepower in its class. Its rate of fire is low, but its powerful damage makes it a strongly recommended weapon for soldiers who dream of becoming heroes.

128203_description=The successor to the 'Frog', the [Frog P] is a Flinger born from excellent attack range and overwhelming rate of fire. It is a weapon that can shore up an Enforcer's weakness in firing range.

128204_description=Whether or not the designer of this weapon was a heavy smoker is unknown, but it is beyond doubt that they loved the acrid stench of gunpowder bursting from the Flinger. Surely there is nothing more fearsome than an Enforcer charging forward through the thick smoke? Just beware, the maker takes no responsibility for respiratory illness caused by the powder smoke!
128205_description=A Flinger that fires adhesive time bombs.\nThe [Landmine] has earned notoriety among enemies as the countdown to death.

128206_description=COLLEIN's [Flubber] is a bounce-type Flinger that effectively controls unpredictable ricocheting rounds. Its magazine capacity is small, but it has excellent weapon balance, and landing a solid hit on the enemy requires a bit of patience, making it a weapon for veteran Enforcers.

128301_description=The [Incinderer] is an entry-level weapon built on DISCORDIA's mass-production system, but with solid damage, rate of fire, and range, it can deliver great power in the right hands.
128302_description=Boasting powerful firepower from specially treated liquid Promethium, the [Burning Heart] is a weapon of lethal power in close-quarters combat.

128303_description=The [Ice Storm] is a special Discharger that uses liquid nitrogen to freeze opponents solid with powerful cold. Before this weapon, enemies will freeze up like castaways caught in an ice storm.

128304_description=Built with DISCORDIA's latest technology, the [HellfireP] is the successor to the Grade B 'Hell Fire' model, boasting even greater firepower and renowned as a top-tier standard-type Discharger even in Grade A.
128305_description=The [Fire WhipP] is the successor to the 'Fire Whip', keeping the same whip-like long range while adding powerful firepower suited to Grade A. A cutting-edge Discharger.
128306_description=A Prison-series Discharger crafted with MODIEN's finest technology. It uses specially treated liquid fuel to unleash powerful cold.

128401_description=A machine gun much favored by the 'Fists of Freedom' who were part of the independence army during the Alternative War of Independence. Its all-purpose performance has carried on to this day, and many Avengers still favor it now.

128402_description=COLLEIN, the company that developed the [Longsword], released the [Claymore] model with boosted firepower to keep up with the improved armor performance of the modern era. Its recoil is somewhat severe so accuracy suffers, but its destructive power alone is more than enough to make up for it.

128403_description=A machine gun with a good rate of fire is bound to have severe recoil and poor accuracy, but the [Rapier] overcame that. MIRAGE found the right balance that minimizes recoil while still guaranteeing firepower, and it's astonishing that they achieved this through the proper arrangement of parts alone rather than new technology.

128404_description=DISCORDIA upgraded the [Bastard], much loved by Grade B Avengers, and released the [Bastard P]. Its enhanced firepower and stability drew an immediate reaction in the market, and it enjoys broad support among Grade A Avengers.
128405_description=The weapon's name comes from how the pain of being shot feels like being cut apart by a chainsaw. Its bullet damage and penetration are that good, so it lives up to its name.

128406_description=An improved version of the Grade B [Dust Storm]. By minimizing recoil and raising accuracy, it can now bring an even more powerful and effective storm of bullets. If you let your guard down thinking your opponent is just spraying a machine gun, you'll end up as bullet fodder, because that opponent just might be firing this machine gun.

128501_description=The Cataclysm wiped out ballparks and the sport of baseball itself, but veteran rocket launcher users have earned the nickname [Slugger]. A standard model favored by Grade B veteran Avengers.

128502_description=A rocket launcher boasting increased penetration and powerful direct-hit damage. For any Avenger confident in their leading shots, it will prove highly effective at putting enemies down.

128503_description=As the saying goes, give an inch and take a mile. If you want to repay a single incoming round with two or three of your own, we recommend punishing your foes with the rapid fire of the [Judgment].

128504_description=With military backing, COLLEIN set out to build a rocket launcher for officers. The model that emerged was the [Beowulf], boasting optimal performance across every metric. The military commissioned its mass production and distributed it to rank-and-file soldiers as well, steadily raising the combat power of the Avengers.

128505_description=MODIEN, a company devoted to specialized weapon development, released the split-warhead rocket [Ettin]. Like the two-headed giant Ettin, once this rocket launcher locks on, enemies will find it hard to escape. Its short range, however, leaves something to be desired.

128506_description=An upgraded version of the [Body Check] model. Armed with far greater destructive power than its predecessor, this P model is a welcome gift for the charging, close-quarters Avenger.

128601_description=A damage-type model that strikes enemies with a powerful optical beam. A high-precision prism was mounted on the energy-amplifying Luna Cube, dramatically boosting energy output. Because of the high-output energy, it is difficult to control and requires some cooling time, so its rate of fire suffers.

128602_description=DISCORDIA, which set the standard for Grade B optical rifles, released the [ThunderstormP], an upgrade of its earlier model, in a bid to capture the Grade A standard-type market as well. The even more powerful optical beam and the highly durable Taconium body deliver stable performance.

128603_description=MIRAGE, master of Luna Cube specialization technology, unveiled the [ShiningdogP], the mightiest destroyer of Grade A. Fitted with a Luna Core rivaling those of Grade S, it surpassed the limits of optical beam output a Grade A weapon could achieve. The high output lowered its cooling time and beam focus rate, so rate of fire and accuracy were somewhat sacrificed.

128604_description=A rapid-fire model built for special forces, boasting shots as precise as a dagger driven into the enemy. High-precision lenses raise the optical beam's focus rate to improve accuracy. If you are confident in your marksmanship, this is the model for you.

128611_description=An optical rifle specialized for long-range attacks. MODIEN's cutting-edge photon-control technology improved the energy accumulation time of the optical ball, enabling long-range attacks. Its rate of fire is somewhat low, but the powerful, large-damage optical ball rounds will pose a great threat to distant enemies.
128612_description=Among ballistic optical rifles, a weapon that leads the Grade A standard. MIRAGE's weapons boast stable performance, and the [Wild Pitch] shines even brighter for it.

128613_description=A high-firepower Grade A model of the GS series. True to a DISCORDIA product, its optical ball rounds, driven by immense energy output, are powerful enough to melt an enemy's taconium armor. The definitive Grade A damage-type weapon.

128614_description=MODIEN opened a new chapter for the elemental-attack optical rifle with the [Venom Striker], and with the [Venom Crusher] they have engineered an even more powerful model. Virulent neurotoxic particles that burrow into the target's nervous system, together with the enhanced optical ball, will usher the target straight to hell.

128701_description=Imagine your head being run through by a long, massive jousting lance. Doesn't the very thought make your knees go weak? As its name suggests, the true power of the [Longest Lance] lies in its headshot-shattering capability. Phantoms confident in their headshots, make the [Longest Lance] your weapon of choice.

128702_description=[Justice] seems to be a weapon that constantly makes a soldier reflect on what true justice really means. To forget everything and fire a single round at the target caught in your scope. Isn't that a soldier's true justice? In any case, [Justice] is without question a damage-enhanced sniper rifle that showcases the combination of an explosive-performance booster and a Luna-alloy rifled barrel. That said, sacrificing rate of fire to boost damage made it a demanding weapon that requires the user's utmost concentration, but that was an unavoidable trade-off.

128703_description=A product was born whose name plainly captures the trademark of the Phantoms: those who slip deep into enemy lines, eliminate their target, and vanish like ghosts without a trace. Fitted with a high-performance rate-of-fire booster, a Luna-alloy rifled barrel forged under ultra-high pressure, and a long-range zoom scope, the [Wraith] is without doubt an outstanding product that catches all three rabbits at once: rate of fire, durability, and long zoom magnification.

128704_description=Riding on the popularity of the Grade C standard-issue sniper rifle [Katana], the [Devil Katana] has been released as the flagship of the Grade A standard-issue sniper rifles. Take up this weapon that gleams with a demonic sharpness, and imagine yourself tearing into the backs of your enemies to your heart's content.

128705_description=COLLEIN has done it big once again. They have released the [Undertaker P], an upgraded version of the Grade B damage-enhanced sniper rifle Undertaker. Beware the [Undertaker P]. The very spot where you stand could become your grave.

128706_description=Another masterpiece is born for Phantoms who prize rate of fire! The Dragon Hunter has been converted into a Grade A model bearing the P suffix. The [Dragon Hunter P] uses a barrel carved from a single billet rather than a jointed one, dramatically reducing all play and wobble, and it employs both a high-performance rate-of-fire booster and a rapid cooling unit at once, delivering a fast and sustained rate of fire.

128801_description=This armament is versatile, able to drain and neutralize a target's shield as well as amplify an ally's shield. With excellent zoom performance and a comparatively good rate of fire, it also posts decent results on the overall performance chart, the very byword of the standard-issue Regulator! [Galaxy]
128802_description=The B Grade [K-2] returns bearing even more powerful damage. The [K-2A1] will bring even greater satisfaction to existing [K-2] users.

128803_description=MODIEN's Solar Project began from the question of whether the photoelectric effect could be added to weapons that emit Luna energy. By miniaturizing and attaching a photoelectric energy module, they developed an even faster energy ejection capability. Thus was born the latest work in the Eclipse series, the [Solar Eclipse].

128804_description=True to the fame of the B-grade [Sparrow]! The [Sparrow F] has arrived, boasting outstanding shield efficiency and rapid shield regeneration. Charge in more boldly. The dependable [Sparrow F] will be holding firm at your back.

128811_description=The [Brownie], a B-grade area-type Regulator, returns armed with new features. Even more astonishing is that it accommodates most of the demands of existing users. Applause to DISCORDIA, maker of the finest weapons that are always convenient to use.

128812_description=The [Rhapsody of Flash], named because the sound made when the luna energy ball is released resembles a rhapsody, is an area-type Regulator boasting a wide attack range and appealing damage. Its only flaw is the significant loss in fire rate and durability from pursuing damage too far.

128813_description=The [Shining Star P], which always tops the A-grade overall performance charts, is a rapid-fire area Regulator that mounts a dedicated luna flux pack, streamlining the process of converting luna energy into circular form to boost fire rate.

128814_description=The [Divine Heal], meaning sacred healing, is a recovery-type area Regulator that delivers high shield-recovery rates not only to the target but also to those around it. Its performance is so highly regarded that legend has it the blueprint was drawn from a divine revelation.

128901_description=Watch a target struck by [Fatality], its warhead loaded with an ultra-high-density plastic explosive to push damage to the limit, and you will understand what true carnage really means.

128902_description=A weapon named [Crimson Spear] because the way it strikes a target resembles being run through by a blood-red spear, it is the all-around prodigy of the Inquisitor class, with a suitable flight time, quick flight speed, and outstanding total flight range.

128903_description=Have you ever experienced the speed of a bastard sword? If you assume that a two-handed blade like the bastard sword must be slow, you are mistaken. The speed it focuses on a target in an instant defies imagination. Just like [Bastard Rider]!

128904_description=Just how far will the [Stinger] evolve? The [Stinger] returns armed with cutting-edge technology: a high-sensitivity remote unit that steadies the warhead's flight, and a vibration-sensing gyro that corrects even the slightest tremor. Add its high price-to-performance ratio, and that is this weapon's greatest strength.

128905_description=[Blazer], fitted with an ignition device fueled by Luna Flux crystals, boasts powerful damage approaching S-class levels. Its very short flight speed and flight range are a drawback, but that will hardly be much of a problem for a veteran Phantom.

128906_description=MODEIN's hit product [Mustang] is reborn under the name [Mustang S]. A self-illuminating LCD that stands out all the more in the dark improves visibility, while a high-sensitivity remote unit and a high-performance system-control chip have dramatically boosted its maneuverability.

129101_description=The [Standard-Issue SH-21A] is a shotgun anyone can use, from Enforcers just entering A-Class to seasoned intermediates with some experience. Don't let that fool you into thinking its performance falls short. Your seniors have already vouched for it. Just remember, authorization from Military Command is mandatory!
129101_summary=[Grade A] Damage-type Shotgun\nCannot be tuned up

129201_description=A minor version of the 'Standard-Issue FLI-3S', called the pinnacle of anti-personnel Flingers, the [Standard-Issue FLI-24A] is the finest A-Class anti-personnel Flinger, useful to everyone from Enforcers who have just entered A-Class to veteran soldiers on the verge of S-Class. If you want to use this weapon, be sure to obtain approval from Military Command!

129401_description=With the appearance of the standard-issue MAC-16B', the government's view on modified weapons turned 180 degrees, and the [Standard-Issue MAC-24A], born under government leadership, is a military-supply-only weapon distinguished by powerful attack power. With government approval alone, you'll get to taste the best performance for the price.

129501_description=Boasting high anti-personnel firepower and low durability consumption, the [Standard-Issue ROC-27A] is an anti-personnel rocket launcher that anyone can use easily and conveniently, from the rookie who has just reached Grade A to the veteran on the verge of Grade S. Just remember that government approval is absolutely required before use.

129701_description=As its name suggests, the Grade A anti-personnel military-issue [Standard-Issue SNI-25A] is a state-of-the-art anti-personnel combat sniper rifle built to slay the enemy through sheer damage.
129701_summary=[Grade A] Damage Sniper Rifle\nCannot Tune Up

129851_description=Despite its shabby appearance, the [Standard-Issue REG-23A] delivers superb performance and, like its predecessor, is a military-exclusive model specialized in anti-personnel combat. Its powerful shield-reduction rate and high allied shield-regeneration faithfully fill the role of a dependable rear-line supporter on the battlefield.

130119_Description=You may wonder why a food you love to eat became the name of a weapon, but look at an enemy hit by the [Meatball] and it will resemble nothing so much as ground meat. That said, don't go licking your lips at the enemy while wielding this weapon!

130120_Description=Inspired by the pit bull terrier, the very symbol of a fighting dog that never lets go once it bites even in death, this weapon mercilessly tears into the enemy before it with rapid, high-speed fire.

130220_Description=This weapon, which spews out bounce-type explosives, hides lethal performance behind its comical name. If looking at [Popcorn] makes you think of butter and onion flavors, you might just get fried by this weapon yourself.
130221_Description=Accompanied by a fierce shrieking blast, the rounds bursting from the muzzle of the [Kiss Mark] will brand your target with a chilling kiss mark.

130420_Description=The [Chupacabra] is said to take its name from a legendary creature of old that drained the blood from livestock down to the last drop. Armed with devastating damage, the mere thought of having every drop of blood drawn from one's body by this weapon is enough to make the enemy shudder.

130421_Description=A monster of ancient legend has been reborn. Like the legend of the Wendigo, the moment you grip this weapon you too will become a phantom of the battlefield, wandering in search of blood.

130520_Description=With the [Pain Recharger] in your grip, you could rightly be called the very incarnation of agony. Only those who have suffered under this vicious weapon, which floods its enemies with endless pain, will feel its terror down to the bone.

130521_Description=On the battlefield, few fates are worse than becoming the target of an Avenger prowling for prey with a [Hyena] slung over their shoulder. These scavengers will blast half-dead enemies away without leaving a trace.
130720_Description=The [Skunk], which fires poison-attribute rounds, inflicts continuous toxic damage on its target. The moment you take up this weapon, there may be no one left around you.

130721_Description=As the name suggests, the Arrowhead Stitch refers to an embroidery technique that stitches like an arrowhead, and it is a sniper rifle favored by female Phantoms. But unlike its feminine name, it is more renowned for delivering powerful shock attacks along with grisly wounds to the bodies of enemies.

130823_Description=Bursting toward its target like a star charged with fierce Luna energy, this weapon is a wild stallion that even its user cannot fully predict. Still, there is truth to the saying, "He who controls the Fever Nova controls the battle."
130853_Description=Evoking a supernova blazing across the dark void, this weapon releases a burst of Luna energy to neutralize and subdue the enemy's shield.

131101_description=If someone were to ask what the best shotgun is, the weapon to recommend without hesitation would be the [Big Shot S]. Rare among standard-type shotguns, this masterpiece is armed with powerful firepower and delivers more than enough performance in both anti-personnel and anti-Hybrid combat. If you can pay the steep price and are diligent enough to renew its biometric recognition periodically, it is the finest shotgun you can pick without any hesitation!
131101_summary=[Grade S] Standard-type Shotgun\nCannot be tuned up

131201_description=The culminating masterpiece of the 'Crater' series, the [Final Crater] leverages perfect weapon balance to draw out firepower unseen in standard Flingers. If you are willing to pay its somewhat steep price, the dream of every versatile Enforcer will fall into your arms, wielding overwhelming power in anti-personnel combat as well as anti-Hybrid combat.

131401_description=Despite being standard-issue, the [Master Fencer] shows almost no gap in attack power against damage-type Machine Guns, with nearly flawless all-around performance. It is a weapon of tremendous capability, representing the pinnacle of every Machine Gun producible with current technology.

131501_description=Fitting for the finest Avenger, the [Hyper Burning Launcher] is the masterwork of Mr. Steve, hailed as the god of rocket launcher tuning. Every major mechanism of the original 'Burning Launcher MKII' has been replaced with cutting-edge components, achieving both stability and extreme damage per second.

131701_description=The killer of the battlefield, the weapon standing at its very summit, is the [Slaughterer 3]. A dustproof/moisture-proof design completely blocks malfunctions caused by foreign matter, and the adoption of an ultra-high-density Luna alloy rifled barrel minimizes recoil, showing painstaking attention to weapon stability. Combined with the optimization of every balance to draw out powerful damage, it is a masterpiece among masterpieces.
131701_summary=[Grade S] Standard Sniper Rifle\nCannot Tune Up

131851_description=The [Lightsaber S], flagship model of the 'Lightsaber' series, mounts a high-output engine and the massive luna energy emitter that supports it to deliver a powerful enemy shield-reduction rate. It is a weapon that offers the utmost satisfaction anytime, anywhere.
131851_summary=[Grade S] Standard Regulator\nCannot be tuned up
138101_description=Beloved by countless Enforcers, the [Duke] boasts top-grade performance with no weak points, earning it the title of duke of the shotgun world on the battlefield.

138102_description=COLLEIN's [Bloody Shower], which seems to reek of blood from its very appearance, is a shotgun with devastating killing power. Designed with a focus on damage and durability, it looks poor on the overall performance charts, but for Enforcers who crave extreme damage it makes for a superb weapon.
138103_description=The [Leonhardt] is a high-performance shotgun capable of achieving outstanding results in open spaces thanks to its wide attack range and excellent rate of fire.

138104_description=A shotgun designed by DISCORDIA's standard weapon mass-production system. Its base performance is excellent, but it responds extremely well to tuning to maximize that performance, making it a weapon recommended for veteran soldiers.

138105_description=Born from a secret COLLEIN project, the [Xleon] is a shotgun that pursues destructive power so strong it can easily tear through even heavy-armor plating, employing an S-grade high-intensity shot barrel and a firepower enhancement device. With everything focused on attack power, it is a weapon to recommend to veteran Enforcers looking to land a one-shot with extreme damage.

138106_description=Developed through a new attempt by MODIEN's top engineering team, the [Surgeon Cross] is the pinnacle of rapid-fire shotguns, boasting an excellent rate of fire, a wide spread angle, and a high pellet count. Unfortunately, its production cost is so high that supply is scarce, and it can only be issued to veteran Enforcers who have distinguished themselves on the battlefield.

138107_description=Called the summit of aim-enhanced shotguns, the [Meteor Shower] was born when PEOPLEZ received a large-scale technology investment from Command. It offers superb aiming across a broad spread angle and pellet count, and its durability boasts exceptional performance as well. Issued only to veterans of a certain rank or higher on the battlefield, its majesty is doubled, making it a magnificent weapon.

138201_description=The [Carpet Bomber] is DISCORDIA's ambitious masterpiece built with the finest technology, a standard-type Flinger with the appealing quality of stable balance that delivers rounds spewing from its powerful firepower onto targets exactly as the user intends.
138202_description=The [Crowd Kill] is a damage-type Flinger named for the powder smoke bursting from rounds as they strike their target, evoking a very cloud of death.
138203_description=With its outstanding rate of fire, this weapon fires rounds so rapidly that it inflicts damage like an earthquake striking the surroundings, earning it the name [Earthquake].
138204_description=The acrid-gunpowder-scented 'Heavy Smoker' returns, upgraded. You, addicted to the smell of gunpowder, are the one who will become the true master of the [Heavy Smoker P].

138205_description=COLLEIN's [Thunderstrike] is the successor to the 'Roaring Blast', a Flinger refined by removing the special material from its rounds and focusing even more on raw destructive power. It raises every aspect of performance to a new level, boasting stable balance and a wide blast radius, and is a wholly appealing weapon praised as the best among its class of Flingers.

138206_description=A Flinger that fires adhesive time bombs.\nThe [Time Bomber P] is a refined model of the 'Time Bomber', known to be extremely difficult to obtain. Only the occasional rumor is heard that some Hybrids modify the 'Time Bomber' and carry it around.

138207_description=The successor to the 'Flubber', which, despite its cute name, unleashes a powerful bouncing attack. Get mesmerized watching the rounds ricochet every which way, and your life will be in danger.

138301_description=The [Goddess of Flame] is an entry-level Discharger built on DISCORDIA's mass-production system. Yet thanks to its faithful base design, it carries the nickname of the strongest mass-production model.

138302_description=Crafted with MODIEN's finest technology, the [Fire Bat Hero] deals thermochemical damage to opponents with powerful firepower and excels at reducing shields. For any Enforcer who has favored the [Fire Bat] series, this is a cutting-edge weapon to covet without question.

138303_description=The [Doctor FreezeP] is the successor to the [Doctor Freeze], its design maximizing the strengths of the previous model. As its predecessor did, the [Doctor FreezeP] will not only neutralize opponents in a short time but bring their very lives to a halt.

138304_description=The [Fire BlasterP] is the successor to the [Fire BlasterS], and as the third model in the line it was built into an extremely powerful and well-balanced Discharger through accumulated know-how. Its base rate of fire is excellent and its range is comparatively long, letting you rain powerful flame down on the enemy.

138305_description=MODIEN's [Call-911 MkII] is a weapon that reinforces the strengths of the 'Call-911', using a specially treated fuel tank and napalm fuel that boasts powerful firepower. The tremendous firepower produced by its triple-injection system is superb, though its short range is a regrettable drawback. Still, any Enforcer who knows the lesson of the one-hit kill, that if you don't kill in a single strike you'll be the one who falls, will choose this weapon without hesitation.
138306_description=Born from GINALON's latest design, the [Melting Machine K] is a discharger boasting devastating range. If you're ready to melt anything and everything, just pull the trigger.

138307_description=Built by DISCORDIA to counter GINALON's [Melting Machine K], the [Empress of the Deep Freeze] uses specially processed liquid nitrogen as fuel to freeze enemies solid with intense cold. Hot stuff is for hot-blooded fools; a cool guy will choose the elegant [Empress of the Deep Freeze].

138401_description=A model released by GINALON Corp. to commemorate the retirement of master weaponsmith GINALON. As befits a standard-issue Machine Gun built on a master's expertise, it boasts solid all-around performance and excellent balance. Being a commemorative model, it is crafted from top-grade Taconium for exceptional durability.
138402_description=COLLEIN Corp., which mainly produces weapons of high destructive and killing power, applied its Flinger and Shotgun technology to a Machine Gun to create this high-firepower model.

138403_description=A Machine Gun commissioned by the Alternative Independence Corps so that a small elite unit could take on numerous foes. If you wish to stand fearless while surrounded by enemies, this Machine Gun once wielded by the heroes of the old independence war comes highly recommended.

138404_description=Upstart weapons company MODIEN unveiled the [Silversword] model to challenge the standard-issue Machine Gun market dominated by established makers. If you are someone who seeks the new, it may be worth giving this new standard-issue Machine Gun a try.

138405_description=If you fell for the raw firepower of the [Chainsaw], you have been waiting for this upgraded version. Its devastating firepower carries over intact, living up to the previous model's reputation, and its distinctive, rugged recoil will win over Chainsaw fans as well.

138406_description=MIRAGE Corp. steadily refined its earlier [Rapier] model to create the P model. This time, despite being a rapid-fire type, it boosts penetration to produce a model any Avenger with precise marksmanship is sure to love.

138407_description=A model that improves upon the standard-issue [Sharpshooter] with enhanced targeting. On battlefields with heavy long-range combat, precise shots are valued over rapid fire, so this model was refined with raised accuracy on top of standard-issue balance to handle long-range engagements.

138501_description=A rocket launcher jointly developed by MIRAGE and the military to be supplied to veteran-class Avengers. Nothing special, but nothing to fault either, it is the definitive standard-issue weapon.

138502_description=A rocket launcher jointly developed by COLLEIN and the military to be supplied to veteran-class Avengers. It was given the name [Conqueror] to signify the ambition of conquering both the damage-type rocket launcher market and the battlefield alike.
138503_description=A model with somewhat improved destructive power compared to existing rapid-fire rocket launchers. No enemy will survive the rain of rockets the [Squall Bomber] unleashes.

138504_description=If the downgraded [Beowulf] model was mass-produced for the enlisted, then the [Beowulf R] was, true to its original intent, crafted for veteran-class officers. Its specs still boast optimal performance in every respect, and it has grown even more powerful.

138505_description=The [Titan Fist] may well be the most powerful of all ranged weapons. Its destructive power rivals that of a close-quarters rocket launcher, so with this weapon in hand you will not fall behind even an Enforcer in terms of firepower. If you value firepower above all, this weapon will be your final choice.

138506_description=A model with the most powerful destructive force among commercially available close-quarters rocket launchers. For the Avenger who needs one big hit, it will be hard to find a weapon with greater destructive power than this.

138507_description=The [Cerberus] series, developed by HLO, has been commercialized by MIRAGE. It has been upgraded with even greater destructive power than before and is now on sale. For soldiers who wanted a split-warhead rocket launcher but could never get their hands on one, this is nothing short of welcome news.

138601_description=Like the blue glow of an optical beam, the rapid fire pouring from this weapon is strong enough to stain the enemy's vision blue. The flagship of MIRAGE's Grade S rapid-fire optical rifles.

138602_description=MODIEN further refined the high-output HND optical resonator used in its predecessor, the [Greyhound], and fitted a large-capacity Luna Core to unveil a Grade S damage-type model. Its optical beam, even more powerful than before, will carry on the fame of the damage-type line.

138603_description=MIRAGE, which dominated the standard-type market, released the P model, an upgrade of the [Flashbound]. Worthy of its reputation, its powerful destructive force and well-balanced performance make it a fitting leader among standard types.

138604_description=GINALON modified its earlier model, the [Resistance], to release a damage-type model boasting overwhelming energy output. Its rate of fire and accuracy, unbecoming of GINALON's reputation, are poor, but it finds its meaning in carrying on the destructive power of its predecessor. There is a rumor that the reason a successor emerged is that the earlier model was first built by GINALON's president himself.

138605_description=A rapid-fire model combining rate of fire and accuracy. If the predecessor [Payback] was made by HLO, this model was made by DISCORDIA at the military's request. This P model was built with the intent of repaying the blow dealt by the [Payback].

138611_description=A model capable of long-range attacks. When their earlier [Unlimited] model became hugely popular as a long-range weapon, MODIEN developed the further-improved [Frost Dawn]. Its long range and wide blast radius reveal a new frontier of possibility for the optical rifle.

138612_description=The mightiest of the Grade S standard-type optical rifles. MIRAGE, strong in standard-type weapons, has found the optimal balance of luna flux energy amplification, rate of fire, and blast radius.

138613_description=A high-firepower Grade S model of the GS series. DISCORDIA's high-capacity luna flux control technology reaches its peak energy output in the [GS-100f]. If you seek a damage-type optical rifle, this will be your final choice.

138614_description=An elemental-attack model that freezes enemies in an instant, crippling their mobility. GINALON upgraded the [Nova] model built by their president in his younger years and pushed forward a project to mass-produce elemental-attack optical rifles. The [Frost Nova] is a masterwork of the elemental-attack class, where the young president's genius meets GINALON's cutting-edge technology.

138615_description=An elemental-attack model that uses virulent neurotoxic particles as a catalyst to paralyze an enemy's nervous system. MODIEN brought in a leading bioengineer to blend the potency of the virulent neurotoxic particles cleanly into the powerful Grade S energy output. If you had a good time with its predecessor the [Venom Crusher], this model will satisfy you too.

138701_description=There was talk that the signature song of the musician most beloved by the engineer in charge of its balance settings was [Driller], which made this very weapon, the [Driller], a hot topic. In any case, it is a highly attractive weapon that applies a tuning method built on stable balance while pushing damage to the very limit of a standard-issue sniper rifle.

138702_description=The [Gungnir], a damage-enhanced sniper rifle modeled after the spear wielded by the supreme god of ancient myth, delivers a truly menacing power with every single shot. Like other damage-specialized sniper rifles, its rate of fire is slow, but it allows for steady aim before firing, making it a fine companion to the many Phantoms who aim for one-shot, one-kill.

138703_description=A song that the legendary sniper 'Betancourt' was said to often hum while moving to the battlefield. 'Betancourt', who would hum that song, returned alive from every battle and came to be called the Immortal. In his honor, the rapid-fire sniper rifle [Eternity Singer] was created. Don't you too wish to become an Immortal? Then keep your eye on the [Eternity Singer].

138704_description=The [Muramasa], whose wounds left behind after piercing an enemy are strikingly different and distinctive from those of ordinary sniper rifles, takes its name from 'Muramasa', a famed blade of the old age well known as a cursed sword. Thanks to that unique mark, it is talked about among the Phantoms and its popularity is steadily on the rise.

138705_description=The [Justice R], an enhanced version of the [Justice], boldly removes the rate-of-fire booster and uses an ultra-high-density Luna-alloy rifled barrel to minimize the recoil generated when firing a round. It is also fitted with a shield-nullifying coating sprayer that raises shield penetration to achieve maximum damage. Displaying outstanding skill in anti-vehicle damage as well, it clearly shows the character of an ultra-high-performance sniper rifle.

138706_description=The [William Tell F], which greatly enhances the rapid-fire capability of the [William Tell], is a sniper rifle boasting the fastest rate of fire in its class. It mounts Grade S rate-of-fire boosters symmetrically at the front and rear of the muzzle, and its long barrel grants very high aiming stability. Its scope, employing a high-purity Luna-crystal optical kit, shortens re-aim time so you can rapidly fire on a single target.

138707_description=The targeting design system of the [Falcon Wing] features Super Multi Coating-treated Lunaflux aiming enhancers symmetrically interlocked within the scope, assisting precise aim and blocking any stray light diffusion for effective targeting. A Luna magnetic gyroscope device is also mounted on the barrel to counter momentary hand tremors, minimizing aiming-point error to the absolute least. The [Falcon Wing] is composed of an assembly of highly precise instruments, making it a sensitive yet powerful weapon that must be handled with care.

138801_description=A model that further strengthens the high-purity luna flux energy emitter of the [Blue Crystal], it actually has a unique origin: a stable conversion of the illegal modifications once carried out among the Blue Kid gang. The signature blue beam of the [Blue Crystal] remains, but this model's sheer power is remarkable.

138802_description=The [LGC-405F] is a mysterious Regulator whose design method and materials are kept strictly secret, a weapon boasting above-average shield regeneration and the highest damage of any instance-type. It still remains a mystery why this weapon is named [LGC-405F], stirring endless curiosity.

138803_description=The [Chain Lightning], whose beam bursting from the muzzle resembles the phenomenon of striking lightning, is renowned for its formidable rapid-fire capability. It is a masterpiece among masterpieces, using the unique method of violently amplifying luna energy waves and releasing them at the target in an instant.

138804_description=The moment the [Wrath of Indra], which shreds an opponent's armor through its outstanding zoom capability, is fired, you will feel to the bone exactly what the wrath of Indra, god of thunder and lightning, truly is.

138805_description=Equipped with S-grade high-purity luna flux energy and a shield amplification device, the [Luna Tracer P] is the crystallization of new technology, mobilizing all of MIRAGE's latest advances. The [Luna Tracer P] is honor itself, usable only by the finest recovery-type Phantoms.

138811_description=[Sekhmet], PEOPLEZ's newest standard-issue area Regulator, looks at a glance like a thoroughly ordinary piece of hardware. Examine it closely, though, and it proves a solid and appealing weapon. Nearly every stat has been greatly improved; it is easy to handle and its parts are readily supplied, earning it fame as a weapon beloved on the harshest battlefields.

138812_description=GINALON, who entrusted the design of this weapon to his own son, was so disappointed by the boy's obsession with damage that he named it [Judas's Left Arm]. Yet contrary to GINALON's worries, on the battlefield [Judas's Left Arm] will prove no traitor, but a powerful ally.

138813_description=The finished form of the Shining series, this weapon bears the name [Shining Storm]. Whoever named it, one has to admit it fits perfectly. You can already picture the enemy recoiling in shock before it, like men caught in a raging thunderstorm.

138814_description=To face [Amon Ra] on the battlefield is already to have taken one step closer to her curse. Boasting tremendous damage, [Amon Ra] gives the feeling of a legendary avatar of the curse brought back to life, standing at the very pinnacle of the damage-type area Regulators.

138815_description=[High Priest], the ultimate form of the Grade A [Priest], delivers performance close to the perfected form of the recovery-type area Regulator. The shield-recovery energy it pours out over a wide area is reassuring just to watch. Even by the overall performance charts its power lives up to its name. The weapon of every recovery-type Phantom's dreams is exactly this: [High Priest].

138901_description=The [Foresight] can be called a weapon that has yet to fully unleash its potential. It scored surprisingly low on the composite performance charts. But anyone who understands this weapon's true worth will have no other choice, we believe.

138902_description=PEOPLEZ, who found little success with the Inquisitor line, launched the [Codename Fury] project to restore their pride. Their expertise, without a doubt, shines through in this weapon as well. The fact that the project name was adopted directly as the weapon's name is another distinctive touch that draws the eye.

138903_description=You should abandon the mistaken notion that the [Bastard Rider R] is merely an upgraded version of the Grade A [Bastard Rider]. Unlike a simple upgrade, the design itself was reworked from the ground up, giving rise to a completely new weapon. We cannot list every change brought about by the new design one by one, but its performance can truly be called the very best.

138904_description=Equipped with the high-sensitivity GX1 remote guidance unit and a ramjet propulsion system with a high-explosive fragmentation warhead, the [Triple X] is a top-grade standard-type Inquisitor whose balance stands out above any Inquisitor released to date.

138905_description=Custom-built to the specifications of Captain Serpico, the hero synonymous with the Inquisitor, the [Basilisk S] delivers damage as fierce as his fiery temperament, pushing overall performance to its peak. It is the finest damage-type Inquisitor of its era.

138906_description=Regarded as the final, perfected form of the [Mustang] series, the [Mustang GTS] hints at extraordinary performance from its very name. Adding a state-of-the-art navigation unit and a high-sensitivity real-time comms sensor to the original [Mustang], it is a masterpiece of the control-enhanced Inquisitor, capable of exceptional handling.

138907_description=The [Dragon Tail], a velocity-enhanced Inquisitor boasting the fastest projectile speed among Grade S weapons, was named [Dragon Tail] because the trail streaming from its rapid rounds resembles the tail of a dragon.

139101_description=Befitting the finest shotgun supplied to Military Command, the mighty damage pouring from its muzzle seems to embody the majesty of an Enforcer staining the battlefield with blood. It still requires Command's authorization like its predecessor and cannot be tuned up, but for Enforcers lacking a dedicated anti-personnel weapon it will be the best choice.
139101_summary=[Grade S] Damage-type Shotgun\nCannot be tuned up

139201_description=A weapon designed to meet the Military Command's demands perfectly, omitting every unnecessary component from the ground up and focused on the finest anti-personnel firepower. Contrary to its simple exterior, the supreme firepower unleashed from its perfect balance will chill your opponent to the bone. Take note that its usage restrictions can only be lifted with authorization from the Military Command.

139401_description=With a host of factory-tuned components applied from the very design stage, the [Standard-Issue MAC-32S] leaves nothing to be desired in attack power. It is the ultimate Machine Gun, the culmination of the government-led anti-personnel weapon diversification program. Its greatest drawbacks are that it cannot be used without government approval and that it delivers less than one-tenth of its performance in contaminated zones.

139501_description=The top-tier model among the anti-personnel combat rocket launchers issued by the military. True to its top-tier status, its high firepower and low durability consumption make it perfectly suited for battlefield use. Another hallmark of this weapon is that anyone granted the military's authorization can use it without restriction.

139701_description=With the powerful damage of each single shot as its charm, this weapon is an S-Grade best-seller frequently used on the battlefield despite its short zoom magnification and small ammo count. Of course, part of the reason is that with government authorization it can be used without paying a great cost, but it is also backed by outstanding performance as an anti-personnel killing weapon.
139701_summary=[Grade S] Damage Sniper Rifle\nCannot Tune Up

139851_description=The [Standard-Issue REG-31S], which represents the pinnacle of anti-personnel Regulators, is famous not only for its performance but also for its outstanding design, unlike conventional military-issue Regulators. It is undoubtedly a weapon so appealing that Phantoms have enlisted in the military just to get their hands on it.
139851_summary=[Grade S] Damage Regulator\nCannot be tuned up
200001_description=Armor for entry-level Enforcers. A low-grade set built to train Enforcers who specialize in close-quarters combat.
200002_description=A mass-produced standard armor built on the test results of the [Frontier E]. Its low price relative to its performance has made it a favorite of many soldiers.
200003_description=A heavy armor that boasts powerful performance thanks to the simplicity of its engine design, despite using a relatively low-output Grade C Lunar Reactor.

200004_description=A prototype produced during the development of the [Private E]. It was decided to issue it to a handful of trainees for monitoring, so only a limited number were distributed for testing.

200007_description=Common-issue armor for new recruits. Many companies bid to provide a low price and decent quality, but among them the heavy-armor specialist FORTE won the contract with a low bid and a simple, sturdy design. The performance is serviceable, but as recruit-grade gear it feels lacking in several respects.

200097_description=Armor re-released by FORTE after correcting and supplementing the Rookie's shortcomings. 201001_description=The most basic armor issued to recruits. Manufactured by Command, the [Standard-Issue A] set is the standard armor for all soldiers and one of the most mass-produced armor sets ever made.
201002_description=A mass-produced standard armor built on the test results of the [Frontier A], beloved by many soldiers for its low price relative to its performance.

201007_description=With its average yet stable performance, the [Rookie A] is the armor set most favored by recruits thanks to its relatively low price and ready availability. Though it has no standout strengths, for recruits the [Rookie A] is becoming not a choice but a necessity.

202002_description=Armor crafted for recruits who have completed basic combat training. Made from Micron Fiber, a newly developed material, it is the most durable among Grade C armor. The moment you don this armor, you will truly feel yourself a Phantom of the Sapiens army.

202003_description=A new-model armor commissioned by the Sapiens army command from FRIO, a specialist in light armor. Thanks to its enhanced Luna Reactor, its performance far surpasses other Grade C armor. This armor was hijacked by the HLO during transport and its whereabouts remain unknown.

210001_description=A Grade B armor set produced by FORTE, a maker specializing in heavy armor for Enforcers. [Warrior] offers solid, dependable defense that serves as a reassuring comfort to Grade B soldiers.

210002_description=The foundation of heavy armor is the shield, and the argument that one should pursue a powerful shield even at the expense of every other function has long been dismissed in the industry as an outdated platitude. That is how much the importance of shield recovery and skills has come to the fore. Yet the [Soldier] set was built around exactly these fundamentals, and with proper support from the rest of the squad it has earned a name as the Grade B armor boasting the finest performance in its class.

210003_description=Marines are often assigned to a wide variety of missions. For that reason they are famous for preferring highly general-purpose armor over any narrowly specialized suit. The [Marine] series, however, blends that all-around performance with exquisitely tuned shield-recovery to boost survival odds even in the most extreme situations, earning its name as armor built for the marines.

210004_description=The name [Closer] was given to mean that you would be hard-pressed to find better performance than this within Grade B, though sadly the maker's ambition did not last long. Even so, it boasts performance worthy of that pride, and in recent times it has come to be used as a byword for a familiar, dependable suit of armor.

210005_description=Boasting the highest shield capacity of any Grade B heavy armor, the [Try] set is FORTE's masterwork, built over a full five years of development following the [Soldier] set. Their dogged 'try' quite literally completed the [Try] set, the strongest armor in Grade B.

210006_description=The hallmark of recovery-enhanced armor is a short shield recovery time and abundant skill energy. 221001_description=The first armor developed by upgrading the existing MOTUS engine, it surpasses previous armor in every spec. At launch its high price met a lukewarm reception, but with its now-stable price and performance it has become a favorite among many Avengers.

221002_description=A shield-enhanced armor released alongside [Full Metal Armor], it was regarded as the finest armor until the M.A (MOTUS Armored) Project series appeared. Recommended for Avengers who prioritize defense.

221003_description=When [Cure A], developed by Command, gained considerable popularity, MOTUS set out to develop a recovery-enhanced armor for commercial use, resulting in the completion of [Saber]. It was made for Avengers who prefer flashy skill-based combat.

221004_description=When the response to [Full Metal Armor] was poor, MOTUS set out to develop [Tactics] in a bid to compete with even higher performance. However, its cost did not match its performance, so only a small quantity was produced before production was halted.

221005_description=Having recruited 'Camuel', HLO set out to produce serious armor to bolster its combat power for the full-scale war of liberation. The mighty shield of the [Combat Suit] further reinforced HLO's forces.

221006_description=Until MOTUS released the [Saber], the [Cure A] was the only recovery-enhancement armor, and its poor performance bred constant complaints among the soldiers. The Merchants' Guild commissioned the master armor-smith 'Aaron' to design a new recovery-enhancement armor.

221008_description=Released as the third series in the M.A Project, which aims to bring MOTUS armor to the masses. By layering carbon-reinforced fiber inside the taconite to soften direct physical impacts, it was built to take on hybrids such as the Duffner and Othello. Due to the cost of anti-contamination coating, only a small quantity was produced before it was discontinued.

221009_description=This armor marks the moment HLO's technology began its rapid rise, built on HLO's massive funding and the engineering skill of 'Camuel'. It is said that some units were seized by the Red Fox Corps during the frequent clashes between HLO and the Red Fox Corps.

221010_description=After drafting the design for the [Helios], the master armor-smith 'Aaron' took interest in the nano-coating method MOTUS had newly developed and created a design applying the same technology. The [Iron Shield] was released to the public after 'Aaron' declared that any design he created would be made available to all.

221011_description=Building on the production of the [Combat Suit], HLO used Taconite to improve engine output. It is said to be the result of testing several experimental technologies, such as a highly concentrated Lunarites reactor.
221012_description=An armor crafted by the enigmatic mad scientist 'Leurelicus' and sold to various armed factions; HLO is believed to be deeply involved in it.
