221501_description=KALIDUM's first mass-produced Grade A standard armor. KALIDUM's Dr. Def was originally a vocalist, but after developing a hearing problem he turned to armor development. His musical talent gave him an exceptional gift for engine tuning, an ability displayed to full effect in the [Tenor] set.

221502_description=A mass-produced armor developed by KALIDUM with a focus on shield defense. It boosts the Luna Reactor output of the [Tenor] set and rebalances the engine toward the shield. Recommended for Avengers who prize defense.

221503_description=A mass-produced armor developed by KALIDUM with a focus on skill usage. KALIDUM's D.N.T linkage system is renowned even among armor manufacturers. Its engine, with improved skill energy utilization and shield regeneration, links effectively with the D.N.T, making it perfect for Avengers who favor flashy skill-based combat.

221504_description=The warriors of the Alternatives are often likened to a single blade. That is, as members of the Alternative community, they consider it the greatest honor to become a sword that guards Eska and strikes down its enemies. In tribute to the spirit of those Alternative warriors, an armor was crafted to be as unbreakable as a strong blade, and it was named the [Blade] set.

221505_description=An armor once developed for the Avengers of the Alternative Independence Corps. With its formidable defense, this model was named [Solid] and boasts the highest shield output among armors of its class.

221506_description=An armor designed by the Merchant Guild by copying KALIDUM's [Soprano] blueprint. In overall performance, including its specialization for skill use, it differs little from the [Soprano]. Following KALIDUM's protests, all units on sale were incinerated. Holding a grudge, the Merchant Guild secretly continues to sell the blueprint.

221508_description=Armor built for the City Guard to prepare for the great Hybrid war. The nano-fiber coated tarconium plating not only carries contamination resistance, but also holds strong defense against physical projectile attacks such as Machine Guns.

221509_description=Armor specially crafted for the Avengers of the old Snake Squad. Equipped with an enhanced Beyond engine, it boasts powerful shield and skill energy production even at low energy output. There are rumors that the Red Fox Clan, once part of the Alternative army, also wear this armor.

221510_description=When KALIDUM's Dr. Deaf went completely deaf, he was cast out of the company. To prove that he was still alive, Dr. Deaf designed [Iron Shield], a masterpiece for the ages. The nano-sensor-equipped taconium armor not only has a chance to reduce incoming damage when attacked, but is also engine-tuned to distribute high-output energy flawlessly.

221511_description=Fitted with a high-output Luna reactor and a shield-dedicated engine, it boasts the strongest shield output in its class. Though its skill energy production is low, the time required to regenerate it is dramatically shortened, delivering top-tier specs that don't fall behind even in skill usage. It is presumed to have been worn by former Snake unit members.

221512_description=A standard-issue armor worn by the Avengers of the "Fist of Freedom," the forerunner of the independence corps, during the Alternative War of Independence. It was named [Spirit] so that the spirit of independence would never be forgotten. Though 30 years have passed since it was made, its performance is in no way inferior to modern armor. It excels especially in shield regeneration delay time.

222001_description=Standard-issue armor made by the Merchants' Guild. Crafted from nanofiber, it boasts excellent durability and delivers solid all-around performance. Because each part of the armor is fitted with sockets to slot skills into, it's recommended for Phantoms who want to use a variety of skills.

222002_description=Built around a high-output Luna reactor, this engine is tuned for shield production, boosting defense. If you want to weather enemy fire behind a generous shield pool, it's worth considering. The only drawback is that the engine's characteristics leave the shield recovery delay a bit long.

222003_description=Fitted with an engine specialized in skill energy production, this armor suits Phantoms who rely heavily on skills. It was much loved by special operatives whose missions demanded frequent skill use. Equip the [Leon] set and you'll be able to toy with your enemies through a dazzling array of skills.

222004_description=Developed under the name Project 'Thief', this armor was, as the name suggests, created for infiltration operatives who slip in unseen like thieves. But the Thief engine mounted here never performed as well as the infiltrators wanted, so the military decided to issue it to regular Phantoms as a morale booster. Its well-tuned balance has made it much loved by ordinary Phantoms.

222005_description=Armor used by a Phantom trooper called 'Shadow' who fought alongside Colonel Merrick in the Alternative War of Independence. Shadow, who mainly ran reconnaissance missions, carried out his duties through dazzling movement rather than skills. Prizing defense above all, Shadow tuned it for shield generation rather than skills, responding effectively to enemy attacks.

222006_description=A model devised by the Merchant Guild to build effective armor around a low-output Luna Reactor. Its power output is modest, but it carries an engine specialized for skill energy generation, making it efficient for skill use. It generates less shield in exchange for boosted shield recovery.

222008_description=Armor made for the Phantoms of the assault force 'Indri Squad'. For the Indri troopers who always lead the charge on the battlefield, it boosts the skill energy production needed to disrupt enemies, and increases Machine Gun defense for Phantoms vulnerable to Avengers.

222009_description=The Grade A light armor model with the best shield and skill energy production. Worn by the Phantoms of the legendary Lycan Squad, this model is no longer produced since its blueprints were lost. If you manage to obtain this armor, seen only in the Sapiens Museum, you may just be one of the lucky ones.

222010_description=This armor, manufactured by Triad, is a model with boosted defense. Fitted with a high-output Luna Reactor, its engine is designed to focus solely on shield production. Its engine tuning is somewhat weak relative to that high output, so it takes a bit of time to recover shield and skill energy.

222011_description=If you want stable defense from a powerful shield, no Grade A light armor beats the [Gargoyle] set. It boasts the strongest shield production in its class. However, the engine's heat demands a rather long regeneration time and has a serious impact on durability.

222012_description=Despite its name, the [Andante] set regenerates its shield far faster than other armor of the same grade. A musical score is drawn on the inside of the armor; it appears a soldier wearing this armor jotted down a melody that came to mind during battle. Perhaps they were inspired by the engine sound made during shield regeneration.

230001_description=When the [Jaguar] set, the first-ever Grade S heavy armor, was first released, it was the envy of every Enforcer. But now that newer tech has been unveiled and it is Grade S in name only, it remains merely a companion to poor heavy Enforcers.

230002_description=The [Elephant] set, once renowned for its ironclad defense, has now fallen behind even the higher A-grade armors. Still, many Enforcers are said to tune up and keep using this armor thanks to its solidly designed foundation.

230003_description=Known as steel muscle, the [Muscle] set is an old release, yet it still sees active frontline duty. Its abundant skill energy and rapid shield regeneration let the wearer roam the battlefield like a monster clad in muscles of steel.

230004_description=Powered by a high-output Luna Reactor, the [Brave] set is an outstanding standard-type armor whose shield rivals that of shield-enhanced types, paired with ample skill energy. True to the saying 'true courage means being brave one second longer than the rest,' it is an armor that can create that one decisive moment.

230005_description=FORTE's A-grade heavy armor, the [Berserker] set, returns further enhanced. Bearing the name [Berserker MKII], this armor is characterized, like its predecessor, by a powerful shield.

230006_description=The [Bastard MKII] heavy armor is a proper recovery-type armor that inherits the Grade A [Bastard] set. Befitting its S-grade status, its abundant skill energy will enable more advantageous tactical maneuvers on the battlefield.

230008_description=The Grade A [Ape] set boasted highly innovative performance in its day, but it proved unsuited to the recent S-grade battles. This led the Sapiens Command to develop the S-grade [Ape MKII], which carries the same characteristics.

230009_description=Designed for the elite warriors of the Lucerno Order, the [Templar] set boasts exceptional performance even among S-grade gear. It is officially classified as a standard type, but its actual performance far exceeds that.  Because it is occasionally obtained in battles against Hybrids, it is one of the mightiest armor sets that every Enforcer longs to wear.

230010_description=The [Giant] is crafted with dragonite alloy across every part of its armor and treated with a special nano-coating; its helmet is modified to mount an anti-damage shield conversion device that, while the shield remains, has a set chance to attenuate incoming attacks.

230011_description=[Titan] is an armor set that was created when an S-grade [Giant] was covertly funneled to a Triad merchant and modified. 230209_description=Designed for the elite warriors of the Lucerno Order, the [Templar] set boasts exceptional performance even among S-grade gear. It is officially classified as a standard type, but its actual performance far exceeds that.  Because it is occasionally obtained in battles against Hybrids, it is one of the mightiest armor sets that every Enforcer longs to wear.

230210_description=The [Giant] is crafted with dragonite alloy across every part of its armor and treated with a special nano-coating; its helmet is modified to mount an anti-damage shield conversion device that, while the shield remains, has a set chance to attenuate incoming attacks.

230211_description=[Titan] is an armor set that was created when an S-grade [Giant] was covertly funneled to a Triad merchant and modified. 230212_Description=A shield-reinforced armor designed by an armor engineer who lost his son in the war, so that no one would ever again be sacrificed the way his son was.

230213_Description=An Enforcer armor born from a careful compromise between defense and skill energy. Ironically, this trade-off shortened the recovery cooldown of both skills and shields, astonishing many.

230302_description=The [Elephant] set, once renowned for its ironclad defense, has now fallen behind even the higher A-grade armors. Still, many Enforcers are said to tune up and keep using this armor thanks to its solidly designed foundation.

230303_description=Known as steel muscle, the [Muscle] set is an old release, yet it still sees active frontline duty. Its abundant skill energy and rapid shield regeneration let the wearer roam the battlefield like a monster clad in muscles of steel.

230304_description=Powered by a high-output Luna Reactor, the [Brave] set is an outstanding standard-type armor whose shield rivals that of shield-enhanced types, paired with ample skill energy. 230505_description=The iron-clad grey bear is back. Built on the Grade A [Grizzly], its outer armor plating has been swapped for a dragonite alloy, and it is fitted with a powerful shield-boosting Pantino engine dedicated to defense, delivering the protection its name deserves.

230506_description=This armor mounts an ultra-compact Luna reactor on each part to shorten the shield regeneration delay. 231001_description=A standard-type medium armor produced by MOTUS for Grade S Avengers. Its durable plating made from Taconite, balanced performance, and comparatively cheap price are luring veteran-class soldiers.

231002_description=By equipping a Luna reactor developed in step with the new MOTUS engine, it became possible to craft shield-enhanced armor without any riveting. This opened up new possibilities for MOTUS.

231003_description=By using a specially processed Luna Core to increase skill energy capacity, the [Shovel] supplied ample skill energy to Avengers who had until then made do with the [Spirit], ushering in the golden age of the Avenger.

231004_description=The Triad modified the [Watchp] and sold it to the HLO, the Red Fox Gang, and others. Where the Triad obtained the [Watchp]'s blueprints, and by what route they acquired them, remains a mystery to this day.

231005_description=A newly reworked version of the armor worn by the Buckler Corps that repelled the first HLO invasion. Having endured repeated massive air raids from the Hybrids, the Sapiens army developed armor with superior shield defense suited to combat in contaminated zones and issued it to the Buckler Corps. The Buckler Corps, which distinguished itself in that campaign, is the forerunner of today's City Guard.

231006_description=Originally designed as a shield-enhancement model, but a mistake by a Triad developer turned it into a skill-utilization-focused design. The energy supply line running from the reactor to the engine was twisted, so shield output dropped, yet skill energy output and regeneration were dramatically improved in an unintended design. Ironically, its unique design has been boosting its popularity.

231008_description=Built from a blueprint drawn up by 'Aaron' at the request of those who craved the Rhesus before the [Rhesus MKII] was released. Forged from Dragonite, dozens of times stronger than Taconium, this armor boasts plating so formidable it can deflect machine gun rounds that punch through a shield.

231009_description=Said to be the finest armor of its era, crafted by the enigmatic mad scientist 'Leurelicus'. A terrifying piece of armor rumored to have claimed countless lives during clinical testing, owing to its ultra-high-density Luna Core and a Luna Reactor driven by indecipherable equations.
231010_description=A damage-absorption armor built from the last blueprint 'Aaron' ever made, engineered to perform even in high-contamination zones.

231011_description=An ultra high-performance armor built by the enigmatic mad scientist 'Reurelicus', who pushed the engine output to the very brink to realize a reinforced shield while preserving all other capabilities.

231012_Description=A mass-produced version of the shield-reinforced Avenger armor. The name comes from the illusion that, when an Avenger wearing the [Red Ribbon] returns from the battlefield, the armor drenched in enemy blood looks as though it were embroidered with a crimson ribbon.

231013_Description=Whoever designed this armor surely imagined an Avenger clad in the [Majestic-12] wreaking havoc behind enemy lines. Its splendid appearance and performance, worthy of the name, draw admiration from all who behold it. A captivating armor said to have been born only after twelve failures in the pursuit of improved form and function.

231305_description=A newly reworked version of the armor worn by the Buckler Corps that repelled the first HLO invasion. Having endured repeated massive air raids from the Hybrids, the Sapiens army developed armor with superior shield defense suited to combat in contaminated zones and issued it to the Buckler Corps. The Buckler Corps, which distinguished itself in that campaign, is the forerunner of today's City Guard.

231306_description=Originally designed as a shield-enhancement model, but a mistake by a Triad developer turned it into a skill-utilization-focused design. The energy supply line running from the reactor to the engine was twisted, so shield output dropped, yet skill energy output and regeneration were dramatically improved in an unintended design. Ironically, its unique design has been boosting its popularity.

231308_description=Built from a blueprint drawn up by 'Aaron' at the request of those who craved the Rhesus before the [Rhesus MKII] was released. Forged from Dragonite, dozens of times stronger than Taconium, this armor boasts plating so formidable it can deflect machine gun rounds that punch through a shield.

231309_description=Said to be the finest armor of its era, crafted by the enigmatic mad scientist 'Leurelicus'. A terrifying piece of armor rumored to have claimed countless lives during clinical testing, owing to its ultra-high-density Luna Core and a Luna Reactor driven by indecipherable equations.
231310_description=A damage-absorption armor built from the last blueprint 'Aaron' ever made, engineered to perform even in high-contamination zones.

231311_description=An ultra high-performance armor built by the enigmatic mad scientist 'Reurelicus', who pushed the engine output to the very brink to realize a reinforced shield while preserving all other capabilities.

231312_Description=A mass-produced version of the shield-reinforced Avenger armor. The name comes from the illusion that, when an Avenger wearing the [Red Ribbon] returns from the battlefield, the armor drenched in enemy blood looks as though it were embroidered with a crimson ribbon.

231313_Description=Whoever designed this armor surely imagined an Avenger clad in the [Majestic-12] wreaking havoc behind enemy lines. Its splendid appearance and performance, worthy of the name, draw admiration from all who behold it. A captivating armor said to have been born only after twelve failures in the pursuit of improved form and function.

231401_description=A standard-type medium armor produced by MOTUS for Grade S Avengers. Its durable plating made from Taconite, balanced performance, and comparatively cheap price are luring veteran-class soldiers.

231402_description=By equipping a Luna reactor developed in step with the new MOTUS engine, it became possible to craft shield-enhanced armor without any riveting. This opened up new possibilities for MOTUS.

231502_description=A shield-enhanced armor that mounts a high-capacity Luna Flux as its energy source, channeling immense energy into the shield. Its engine tuning focused on shield use leaves skill energy efficiency somewhat lacking, but it's a welcome item for Grade S Avengers who prioritize defense.

231503_description=A skill-dedicated armor that mounts a high-capacity Luna Flux as its energy source, channeling immense energy into skill energy. Its engine tuning focused on skill energy use leaves shield efficiency somewhat lacking, but it's a welcome item for Grade S Avengers who prioritize skill combat.

231504_description=A model that upgrades overall performance by tuning the engine of the Grade S standard-issue armor [Punisher]. Produced after Dr. Deft went completely deaf, this product was delivered to the military but was rejected on the grounds of Dr. Deft's illness. The armor left in the warehouse was later looted by the HLO and its whereabouts became unknown.

231505_description=A newly modified model of the armor worn by the Velites unit that repelled the HLO invasion in the past. In the early days of Eska's founding, the Alternative army, which faced a major offensive from the Hybrids, developed armor with superior shield defense suited for combat in contaminated zones and supplied it to the Velites unit. The Velites unit, which rendered distinguished service at that time, is the predecessor of today's City Guard.

231506_description=A model originally designed as a shield-reinforced type, but a mistake by the Triad developer turned it into a skill-focused design. The energy supply line running from the reactor to the engine was warped, lowering shield production, but instead an unintended design emerged that dramatically improved skill energy production and regeneration. Thanks to its unique design, it is actually rising in popularity.

231508_description=Armor forged from Dragonite, dozens of times stronger than Taconium. Crafted from the finest metal on earth, this armor boasts armor plating so formidable it can deflect machine gun rounds that have punched through a shield.

231509_description=A standard-model armor created by Triad developers by combining Sapiens and Alternative armor. By merging the strengths of the Sapiens shield-enhancement armor and the Alternative recovery-enhancement armor, they produced armor with good efficiency in both shield and skill energy.

231510_description=A model reverse-engineered by the Merchant Guild after analyzing the armor of Sapiens soldiers who invaded the Alternative Undercity. Because it is crafted from expensive nano-sensors and dragonite that the Merchant Guild cannot purchase, it was never produced as a finished product. Thanks to the nano-sensors, it has a special function that reduces damage to the struck area with a certain probability.

231511_description=Armor crafted by an HLO developer known as 'Leurelicus', a model with outstanding shield defense. When Dr. Def saw this [Charlemagne], which boasts the highest shield output in its class, he was astonished. Not because of its performance, but because the signature engraved on the engine bore the name 'Leurelicus'-the name of the daughter he had believed to be dead.

232001_description=A standard Grade S armor set developed by the Merchant Guild. Lacking advanced technology, the Merchant Guild produced nothing remarkable in terms of performance, but it compensated for its shortcomings with quality materials. It uses new nanofiber for strong durability. The black nanofiber is said to evoke a bat, so it was named the [Bat] set.

232002_description=After recruiting FRIO's engine technicians, the Merchant Guild developed the [Blackhawk] set with increased power output and shield generation. Specialized in shield defense compared to the [Bat], this armor appeals to soldiers with its superior durability and defense.

232003_description=FRIO built this armor for the Alternatives' Snake unit, but after being rejected it is now sold to Sapiens soldiers. Tailored to the Snake unit's special operations, it focuses on skill energy production, and reinforces defense by shortening the shield regeneration delay in exchange for a lower shield capacity.

232004_description=When the [Snake] set was turned down by the Alternative military over power and balance issues, FRIO delivered the [Snake MKII], rebalanced by raising power output and shield defense while lowering skill energy. This armor vanished during transport, and the officer in charge is suspected of having modified it to suit the Sapiens military before selling it off to the Triad.

232005_description=A shield-defense-enhancing armor named after the shield carried by ancient Greek soldiers. It is tuned to channel the power drawn from the high-output Luna Reactor primarily into shield generation. Its shield recovery time and skill energy capacity leave a little to be desired, but if you need a dependable barrier on the battlefield, standing alongside the ancient soldier's shield will be a comfort.

232006_description=A Grade A light armor specialized in shield recovery and skill energy utilization. Watching a Phantom's dazzling skill combat is almost like witnessing magic. Named after a great sorcerer, this armor will make the Phantom, who values flashy skill combat, feel as if clad in a robe of magic.

232008_description=The Phantom can slip through the shadows with a variety of skills, but is helpless against the Avenger's detection abilities. The [Mist] set is a special suit of armor made from cutting-edge Taco-nanofiber, engineered to withstand physical projectile fire such as the Avenger's machine gun attacks.

232009_description=[Poltergeist] is armor of unknown manufacture, fitted with the finest skill-energy-generating engine among all Grade S light armor. Even the unit that wears this armor remains unidentified, leading many to believe it is one of the secret weapons built for special operations.

232010_description=Despite its high-output Luna Reactor, its shield and skill-energy output are somewhat lacking, but the Pegasus sensors fitted to the nanosuit cushion some of the damage taken at the point of impact.  Pegasus sensor technology is so intricate that mass production has proven impossible.

232011_description=Apparently custom-built for Phantoms on covert missions, the [Chimera] set is fitted with a Chimera engine that maximizes shield output, giving it the best shield defense in its class.

232012_Description=Slipping through the darkness and roaming the battlefield at will, the Phantom is a truly fearsome presence. People came to call them shadow warriors. And the finest armor befitting such a shadow warrior is none other than the [Shadow Armor].

232013_Description=If Phantoms, the masters of stealth and assassination, are also granted the benefit of a reduced shield recovery delay, they could rightly be called the true lords of terror. 237807_description=A top-grade shield-enhanced armor set crafted in honor of Ironheart, the hero who once belonged to the Alternative Independents. Many veteran Enforcers don [Ironheart] and charge into the heart of enemy lines, ravaging the Sapiens as they dream of becoming the second Ironheart.

237901_description=An all-around performance-boosting armor set with a striking blue body. The blue hue on the shoulders and neck comes from the Luna Flux emitted by the Luna Reactor. To raise overall performance, the Luna Reactor runs more heavily, and to vent the heat this generates, part of the outer plating is shaped to act as a cooling unit.

237902_description=Famous for reducing enemies to tears by its mere appearance, the [Cry S] channels most of the output pouring from its two twin engines into shield amplification. A shield-enhanced armor built to protect the wearer's life.

237903_description=A recovery-enhanced armor that uses a system which dramatically shortens shield regeneration delay. Using the backup Luna Reactor mounted on the back, it can rapidly supply shields the moment regeneration is needed.

237904_description=A standard armor set equipped with a backup Luna Reactor on the back and two heavy engine rooms. Its overall balance is so well-tuned that it delivers excellent performance on its own, but the true power of the [Reternant E] emerges through tune-ups.

237905_description=The [Sandman MKII], which lines the interior of every part with nano-Kevlar carbon fiber to push penetration defense to the extreme, lives up to its nickname of Machine Gun Avenger Killer and is especially effective at defending against machine guns.

238501_description=Armor built for elite troopers heading into skirmishes and full battle. Fitted with the latest engine and an ultra-high-output Luna reactor, its immense energy output multiplies both shield and skill energy capacity. If there is an Avenger about to charge into battle right now, we recommend arming up with the [Agema].

238502_description=KALIDUM launched the Reboot Project, an initiative to upgrade popular lower-grade models for battlefield use. Its very first product was the [Freedom MKII]. Maximizing the strengths of the engine specialized for shield use, it mounts an ultra-high-output Luna Reactor to push shield defense all the way to the Grade S limit.

238503_description=The second product of KALIDUM's Reboot Project. The beloved [Spirit] Standard-Issue armor was fitted with a new socket system and the latest engine, transforming it into armor optimized for skill combat. The Alternative spirit of independence will live on through the [Spirit S] series.

238504_description=The third entry in KALIDUM's reboot project. In battlefield combat where you can afford to neglect neither shields nor skills, soldiers naturally favor armor that strikes a solid balance between the two. Because it was built by refining the [Revenant] set worn by the valiant Snake squad members who proved their mettle in battle, it is regarded as a proven standard-issue armor.

238505_description=The [Beholder], renowned for its outstanding defense against physical rounds, has been reborn as the [Beholder MKII], its armor plating made even stronger with Dragonite alloy. Once you don this armor, you will have no reason to fear the hail of bullets on the battlefield. Its high-output Luna Reactor and new engine are tuned for optimal performance balance, inheriting its predecessor's renown intact.

238506_description=This nano-coded armor is fitted with special nano-sensors that grant it the ability to reduce damage at the point of impact with a certain probability. Because the nano-sensors consume a great deal of energy, an ultra-high-output Luna Reactor has been installed, which places some strain on durability. However, since shield and skill energy output are also increased, it is the finest choice if performance is what you are after.

238507_description=The final work of KALIDUM's Reboot Project. Equipped with an engine boasting the finest S-Grade shield generation, no model can match its shield defense. If you want to face enemy fire on the battlefield without fear, [Solid S] is the choice you cannot avoid.

239001_description=An armor that boasts the highest output in its class, equipped with an ultra-high-output Luna Reactor and a high-capacity Luna Core. 239002_description=A model that fits the shield-boosting [Hela] set with a new Luna Reactor and a new engine to push shield defense to the maximum. It sharpens its competitive edge by somewhat shortening the shield regeneration delay that was the [Hela] set's weakness. Phantoms thirsting for defense should take a close look at the [Hela MKII] set.

239003_description=Lightening the Luna Reactor cut power output somewhat, but efficiency was boosted by fitting an engine that shortens shield and skill energy regen delay to the absolute minimum. If you're a Phantom who's always fretted over shield and skill energy regen times, the [Puma S] set comes highly recommended.

239004_description=Standard-issue armor built for officer-class Phantoms. Its new engine strikes an optimal balance between shield and skill energy production. Because so much attention went into the engine, cost-cutting forced the use of a slightly less durable material—that's its one flaw. But officer-class Phantoms don't have to worry about repair bills, do they?

239005_description=An upgraded version of the [Indri], beloved for its enhanced penetration defense. Its nanosuit, woven from Tako-nano fiber, raises protection against Avenger Machine Gun fire even higher, and its well-judged distribution of shield and skill energy production rates better than the standard model. Now don the [Indri MKII] and stand tall even before a Machine Gun. Just be ready for frequent repairs.

239006_description=A model derived by analyzing Triad's earlier [Unicorn] design and upgrading it into an S-Grade damage-absorption type. A Pegasus sensor mounted on the nanosuit cushions some of the damage to the struck area. Its weak durability is a bit of a letdown.

239007_description=PRIO, in partnership with the military, developed a new shield technology called [Anti-Field] that secures a large amount of shielding from minimal power output.
